title: Glowing scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='40' ry='10' fill='#1b2a4a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='22' y='68' width='48' height='9' rx='4' fill='#39c6ff'/>
  <rect x='22' y='68' width='48' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7fe4ff'/>
  <!-- deck tread stripes -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='3' height='5' rx='1' fill='#0f6a94'/>
  <rect x='38' y='70' width='3' height='5' rx='1' fill='#0f6a94'/>
  <rect x='46' y='70' width='3' height='5' rx='1' fill='#0f6a94'/>
  <rect x='54' y='70' width='3' height='5' rx='1' fill='#0f6a94'/>
  <rect x='62' y='70' width='3' height='5' rx='1' fill='#0f6a94'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='9' fill='#c9f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='5' fill='#39c6ff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='2' fill='#0f6a94'/>
  <!-- back wheel -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='76' r='9' fill='#c9f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='76' r='5' fill='#39c6ff'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='76' r='2' fill='#0f6a94'/>
  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M8 70 A10 10 0 0 1 28 70 L24 70 A6 6 0 0 0 12 70 Z' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <!-- steering column -->
  <rect x='70' y='32' width='6' height='38' rx='3' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <rect x='71' y='32' width='2' height='38' fill='#ff9ccb'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='58' y='28' width='28' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffcf3f'/>
  <!-- grips -->
  <rect x='58' y='28' width='7' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <rect x='79' y='28' width='7' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='5' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- glow rays from wheels -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#39c6ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='76' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#39c6ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
